Java Import.description: Import a Java class by its simple name

Immutable Binding.description: A local binding inside a method (a shared field of a static class is written the same way)

Function.description: A static method (inside a static class)

Private Class.description: A class only this file can use; classes are public by default

Positional Function.description: Declare a function called with positional arguments, Java style: name(1, 2)

Async Function.description: Declare a function that runs on its own virtual thread; call it with await

Await.description: Run an async function on its own virtual thread and wait for its result

Await All.description: Start several async calls together and wait for all of them (a List of the results)

Main.description: A program: a static class with main

Subclass.description: Declare a class with a superclass

Static Class.description: Declare a class with class-level methods and shared fields; it is never instantiated

Constructor.description: A class's own constructor: a method named like the class

New Fact.description: Create an instance; a fact class writes the fact to TidesDB

Mixfix Operator.description: Declare an operator: the typed captures of the pattern are the parameters

Override.description: Override a method of the superclass

For Loop.description: Iterate a list, a range or a selection of facts

While Loop.description: Repeat while a Boolean condition is true

Switch.description: A switch block: a case falls through to the next until break

Try Catch.description: Catch an exception: error is (kind: Atom, message: String)

Throw.description: Raise an exception; its type is Nothing

Query.description: Select facts of a class and read them

Insert.description: Store a new fact; an error if the key exists

Link.description: Store an edge between two stored facts

Join.description: Walk links to facts of another class; returns typed rows (left, right, properties, depth)

Atom Predicate.description: Test whether a value is a data atom

Type.description: Return the type name of a value

Fact class.description: Declare a class whose instances are stored in the database

Database import.description: Use the TidesDB fact store and choose its directory

Interface.description: Declare an interface: default methods, static methods and constants

Implementing class.description: Declare a class that implements an interface

PageRank.description: PageRank scores of the facts of a class over the stored links (import org.felidae.graph.algorithms)

Communities.description: Louvain or Leiden communities of the facts of a class (import org.felidae.graph.algorithms)

BreadthFirst.description: Breadth-first traversal from a fact (import org.felidae.graph.algorithms)

TopologicalOrder.description: Topological order of the facts of a class; a cycle throws (import org.felidae.graph.algorithms)

Shared Field.description: A shared field of a static class (inside the class)

Static Init.description: Statements run once when the static class is loaded: facts and links

Database Location.description: Where the database lives, set when the static class is loaded

Generic Class.description: A class with a type parameter

Generic Method.description: A method with a type parameter (inside a static class)

Abstract Class.description: A class that is never constructed itself, with an abstract method

Abstract Method.description: An abstract method: a result type and no body (in an interface or an abstract class)
